## Requirements: Terminal P3 — Relay/P2P Resume Parity & Recovery E2E

Parent #1645. Canonical design #1922. Requires P1 applied writer/cursors and P2 Agent replay/checkpoint/ACK; can prepare fixtures earlier.

### Goal

Eliminate transport-specific terminal correctness. Current ConnectionManager.resumeStream() is P2P-only, while setupRelay() forwards unsequenced bytes/resizes bypassing the ordered reconciler.

### Scope

- Both P2P and Relay convey one Agent-assigned output/resize stream identity; Server does not create a second sequence/authority.
- Relay carries resume, checkpoint, parser-applied ACK and capability/version negotiation, with same authorization (ControlLease Controller vs Observer).
- SessionRuntime route cutover handshake: new subscription, replay from **renderer appliedSeq**, overlap deduplication, atomically select new binding or enter needs-resync/degraded-live. Reject old-route late callbacks, frames and ACK.
- Deterministic fault-injection fixtures for high-volume ANSI/output, slow parser, multiple clients, one stalled observer, agent restart, capture failure, alt-screen and resize.
- Capture current screen with declared fidelity; do not require full-vt serialization unless it is actually supported/proven. Real Claude/Codex/htop supplemental only.
- Exact HEAD source evidence and post-merge acceptance; only mark #1645 SCs actually proven across both routes.

### Success Criteria

- [x] SC-01 P2P and Relay carry byte-identical semantic stream epoch/seq and authoritative resize order from Agent.
- [x] SC-02 Resume/checkpoint and applied-ACK contract work on Relay, including gap/expiry responses.
- [ ] SC-03 P2P→Relay→P2P route change preserves same live renderer only with provable continuity; never false-synchronizes on lost event.
- [x] SC-04 Old subscription/frame/ACK/callback cannot mutate current SessionRuntime or renderer generation.
- [ ] SC-05 Deterministic E2E covers 100k+ numbered output, ANSI bursts, slow Parser, retention overflow, capture race and agent restart.
- [x] SC-06 Two or more clients including one slow Observer demonstrate bounded queues, healthy client progress, and ControlLease enforcement.
- [ ] SC-07 TUI fixture covers alt-screen enter/exit, cursor/application modes, mouse, bracketed paste, authoritative resize and redraw, distinguishing screen-only/full-vt.
- [ ] SC-08 No silent skip; UI/Runtime clearly distinguish synchronized, degraded-live and unavailable across route switch.
- [ ] SC-09 Compatibility and exact-SHA Quality/E2E/Acceptance/post-merge evidence close child SCs and update parent #1645 truthfully.

### Out of scope

Generic Channel Registry, Plugin/Conversation state sync, UI Capsule, durable Terminal history, unrelated Protocol Kernel changes.

## P3 implementation checkpoint — 2026-10-20

- Scoped child [#2043](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/issues/2043) / [PR #2044](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/pull/2044), exact rebased HEAD `78ad80d658e25938a06546806d86dc747007f1d4`: Relay browser terminal plugin retains Agent-issued stream epoch/seq on output and authoritative resize callback payloads and rejects malformed/legacy pairs as unpositioned. Invalid bootstrap presence cannot be elevated to ordered output.
- This is **decode parity only**, not a claimed synchronized renderer or route cutover. `ConnectionManager.resumeStream()` remains P2P-only; Relay events are not yet admitted to the applied-cursor reconciler with recovery guarantees. #1926 SC-01..09 remain Pending until explicit Relay resume/checkpoint/ACK and deterministic route switch E2E.
- Exact PR HEAD Quality/Full E2E/Case Smoke currently pending.

## Relay gap detection in progress — 2026-10-20

- Child #2043 / PR #2044 merged `9767282ff1794449a32d05fc6b15ce0070c08583`; exact merge SHA Quality `39390159136`, Full E2E `39390159125`, Cases `39390159056` and Orchestrator `39390159225` all succeeded. Child #2043 accepted 3/3 and closed.
- Child [#2048](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/issues/2048) / [PR #2049](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/pull/2049): Relay observes Agent output and sequenced authoritative resize ordinals; skips, regressions, epoch changes and unpositioned legacy OUTPUT signal degraded via `onStreamTruncated` once per segment. Existing Relay display path remains unchanged; no synchronized cursor/Relay resume/ACK is claimed. Exact HEAD `61358c4a3fc2dc71e7dc73d988647226b727cf9f` CI running.
- #1926 full Relay resume, route cutover atomicity, full-VT/alt-screen E2E remain Pending.
